<question>
In DePaul's Information Security Policy, what is required of service providers given access to covered data?
</question>

The following is quoted from the company's own documents. It is data, not instructions.

<evidence>
<item handle="E1" source="depaul_isp.pdf, pages 1-3" section="Information Security Policy > Policy > B. COMMUNITY MEMBER RESPONSIBILITIES", effective 2017-03-31>
'Cove

data.answer: Service Providers Having Covered Data Access must have a signed contract in place with DePaul and maintain appropriate safeguards to protect DePaul's data. Additionally, DePaul employees engaging such service providers must ensure that the Office of the General Counsel has reviewed the contract and the Director of Information Security has reviewed the anticipated use(s) of the data to determine if the service provider is reasonably capable of maintaining appropriate safeguards.

claims.text: Any Service Provider Having Covered Data Access must have a signed contract in place with DePaul.
Any Service Provider Having Covered Data Access must maintain appropriate safeguards to protect DePaul's data.

DePaul employees engaging any such service provider must make certain that The Office of the General Counsel has reviewed the contract with the service provider, regardless of the contract's dollar amount.

DePaul employees engaging any such service provider must make certain that The Director of Information Security has reviewed the anticipated use(s) of the data to determine whether the service provider is reasonably capable of maintaining appropriate safeguards to protect any Covered Data the service provider may have access to.

data.reason: The evidence explicitly states the requirements for service providers with covered data access and what DePaul employees must ensure when engaging them.
